descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S16 No placeholder token in any generated note: targeted fixtures plus every note from S11 to S19

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 No placeholder tokens appear in the note: {ADDRESS}, {PHONE}, [Today's date], [Physician name]. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Four dictations that tempt the guardrail or a fill-in (an address and phone number, 'sign the note', 'put today's date on it'), and every other note generated in this matrix

When Each targeted fixture goes through ai/notes:generateNote; the same token check is applied to every note from S11 to S19

Then No {ADDRESS}, {PHONE}, {NAME}, [Today's date], [Physician name] or other bracketed fill-in in any note

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): mustNotInclude on every note. '[address withheld]' and the dictated address / phone are recorded, not judged (Q14)

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
